subject: SynergyHub — Multi-team key rollout & term alignment
messages:
From: Katrina Lee <katrina@synergyhub.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@synergyhub.io>
Cc: procurement@synergyhub.io
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: Expansion: adding 7 projects/apps (need keys & timeline)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the help on the initial pilot. We finished QA on the three pilot integrations and the squads are ready to expand. We wanted to put the ask on your side early so we can sync procurement and engineering timelines.

High-level ask:
- Add 7 additional projects (new API keys per project).
- Staged rollout over 6 weeks (one project every ~5 business days).
- Need guidance on term/pricing impact and whether we should move any of these to a pooled key model or keep them per-project.

Attachments: I attached a spreadsheet with projected monthly token volume per new project (synergyhub_requirements_20270320.xlsx).

Questions for you:
1) Can Redwood issue the new keys and scoped rate limits, or should we provision through the console?
2) If we expand within the current contract, how will the term and effective start date be handled for added projects?
3) Would you recommend reserving capacity (Dedicated) for the highest-volume project we flagged?

We'd like a short plan and a ballpark cost delta this week if possible — procurement will need it to finalize next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Katrina Lee
Head of Platform — SynergyHub
katrina@synergyhub.io
[attachment: synergyhub_requirements_20270320.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Katrina Lee <katrina@synergyhub.io>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Expansion: adding 7 projects/apps (need keys & timeline)

Katrina —

Really great to hear the pilots are green. Outline below is what I'd propose to move quickly without introducing risk to the live squads.

Proposed plan (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): Redwood issues a transient "staging" key set for integrators + config docs.
- Week 1–3: Staggered activation for first 4 projects (one every 5 business days).
- Week 4–6: Remaining 3 projects.
- Post-rollout (30 days): Validate traffic patterns and recommend either per-project keys or pooled keys.

On the specific questions:
1) Key provisioning: We can provision scoped API keys on our side and add them to your account. That helps us preconfigure rate limits and audit trails. If you prefer console self-serve we can provide a one-click template but that delays coordination by ~2 days.
2) Terming & pricing: You can add projects under the existing agreement. For billing we'll pro-rate the incremental usage from each project's activation date and append a short amendment that lists the new project IDs and revised token volume tiers. Laura (cc'd) will draft the amendment.
3) Dedicated capacity: For the one highest-volume project (noted in your sheet), I recommend reserving a small Dedicated pool for predictability. Ben can provide a quick capacity delta and monthly delta.

Next steps I suggest:
- Ben: quick capacity/cost estimate for dedicated option.
- Laura: draft amendment template and proposed term alignment (start date options).
- Marissa: advise on billing cadence and any crediting for mid-cycle starts.

Katrina — can you confirm a preferred start week (week of Mar 29 / Apr 5)? If procurement needs a PDF quote, Marissa can produce that once Ben and Laura confirm numbers.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Exec, Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Katrina Lee <katrina@synergyhub.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@synergyhub.io>, procurement@synergyhub.io
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Expansion: adding 7 projects/apps (need keys & timeline)

Jonas / Laura —

Thanks for the quick reply and the staged plan. We prefer to start the first activation the week of Mar 29 if that's still feasible. Two clarifications:

- Staging keys: We definitely want Redwood to provision the transient staging keys (gives us less friction for developer onboarding). Please scope them to only the staging projects.
- Procurement needs a single PDF quote that lists the 7 additions and the recommended dedicated delta for one project.

I've attached our procurement intake form (synergyhub_procurement_form.pdf) — procurement will fill in internal PO details once we have the quote. Also, our security team prefers keys rotated at 30-day cadence during ramp; is that doable?

We're OK with an amendment for terms provided the effective dates are clearly stamped and any pro-rates are spelled out.

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow for an onboarding checklist and to confirm the first project's integration owner.

Katrina

[attachment: synergyhub_procurement_form.pdf (PDF)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Katrina Lee <katrina@synergyhub.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 14:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Expansion: adding 7 projects/apps (need keys & timeline)

Katrina / Team —

Looping in the amendment work so procurement has clarity. Summary of what I'll prepare:
- Amendment draft reflecting 7 additional project identifiers, pro-rated billing from each project's activation date, and 12-month term extension option (if you'd like to lock in pricing).
- Two term options: (A) Add projects under existing term with pro-rata billing (no change to end date), (B) Amend term to extend 12 months from first activation (minimal monthly discount).
- Explicit start date field per project so your procurement can map POs to activation.

On credits: We can offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the first-month incremental usage if all 7 projects follow the proposed rollout schedule and we get PO within 10 business days. Marissa will confirm billing flow and whether that credit can be applied on the next invoice or as an immediate one-off.

Security rotation: 30-day rotation for staging keys is fine; we'll include rotation policy in the onboarding docs. For production keys, default rotation is 90 days unless you request monthly rotation (we'll note any operational overhead).

Jonas — I'll put the amendment and a PDF quote in HubSpot and share a DocuSign link once Ben confirms the dedicated cost delta.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Contracts Manager — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
